{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module OAuth.Redirect where

import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as C8
import Data.Word (Word8)
import Data.Bits (xor, (.&.), shiftR)
import Data.List (isPrefixOf)
import Network.URI (parseURI, uriAuthority, uriRegName, URI(..))

-- | Registered OAuth callback domains
allowedDomains :: [String]
allowedDomains = ["app.example.com", "auth.example.com", "cdn.example.com"]

-- | Deserialize a redirect_uri from an uploaded OAuth state blob
-- The blob format is: [2-byte length][uri bytes][4-byte checksum][padding]
data OAuthState = OAuthState
  { redirectUri :: String
  , clientNonce :: ByteString
  , timestamp   :: Int
  } deriving (Show)

-- | Compute a simple checksum over bytes
computeChecksum :: ByteString -> Word8
computeChecksum bs = BS.foldl' xor 0x5A bs

-- | Parse length field from 2 bytes (big-endian)
parseLength :: ByteString -> Int
parseLength bs
  | BS.length bs >= 2 = fromIntegral (BS.index bs 0) * 256 + fromIntegral (BS.index bs 1)
  | otherwise = 0

-- | Validate that a URI's host is in our allowed list
validateRedirectHost :: String -> Bool
validateRedirectHost uri =
  case parseURI uri of
    Nothing -> False
    Just parsed ->
      case uriAuthority parsed of
        Nothing -> False
        Just auth ->
          let host = uriRegName auth
          in any (\allowed -> allowed `isExactHost` host) allowedDomains

-- | Check if the actual host exactly matches an allowed domain
-- No suffix matching - must be exact equality
isExactHost :: String -> String -> Bool
isExactHost allowed actual = actual == allowed

-- | Deserialize the OAuth state from an untrusted upload
deserializeOAuthState :: ByteString -> Either String OAuthState
deserializeOAuthState blob
  | BS.length blob < 8 = Left "Blob too short"
  | otherwise =
    let uriLen = parseLength blob
    in if uriLen > 2048 || uriLen < 1
       then Left "Invalid URI length"
       else if BS.length blob < 2 + uriLen + 1 + 16
            then Left "Blob too short for declared length"
            else
              let uriBytes = BS.take uriLen (BS.drop 2 blob)
                  checksumByte = BS.index blob (2 + uriLen)
                  expectedChecksum = computeChecksum uriBytes
                  nonceStart = 2 + uriLen + 1
                  nonceBytes = BS.take 16 (BS.drop nonceStart blob)
                  -- Reject any null bytes in URI before unpacking
                  hasNullBytes = BS.elem 0 uriBytes
                  uri = C8.unpack uriBytes
              in if hasNullBytes
                 then Left "Null bytes in URI"
                 else if checksumByte /= expectedChecksum
                      then Left "Checksum mismatch"
                      else if not (validateRedirectHost uri)
                           then Left "Invalid redirect host"
                           else Right OAuthState
                             { redirectUri = uri
                             , clientNonce = nonceBytes
                             , timestamp = 0
                             }

-- | Process the OAuth callback - this is the critical security gate
processOAuthCallback :: ByteString -> Either String String
processOAuthCallback uploadedBlob =
  case deserializeOAuthState uploadedBlob of
    Left err -> Left $ "Deserialization failed: " ++ err
    Right state ->
      let uri = redirectUri state
      in if validateFinalRedirect uri
         then Right uri
         else Left "Final validation rejected redirect"

-- | Final redirect validation - defense in depth
-- Checks the URI after deserialization for safety
validateFinalRedirect :: String -> Bool
validateFinalRedirect uri =
  case parseURI uri of
    Nothing -> False
    Just parsed ->
      case uriAuthority parsed of
        Nothing -> False
        Just auth ->
          let host = uriRegName auth
              -- Ensure no null bytes or control chars in host
              hasControlChars = any (\c -> c < ' ') host
              -- Verify scheme is https
              schemeOk = uriScheme parsed == "https:"
          in schemeOk && not hasControlChars && validateRedirectHost uri

-- | Entry point for handling uploaded OAuth state files
handleUpload :: ByteString -> IO (Either String String)
handleUpload rawUpload
  | BS.length rawUpload < 2 = return $ Left "Upload too short"
  | otherwise = do
    let encodingFlag = BS.index rawUpload 0
        payload = BS.drop 1 rawUpload
    -- Flag 0x01 means the payload has been XOR-obfuscated with key 0xFF
    let decoded = if encodingFlag == 0x01
                  then BS.map (`xor` 0xFF) payload
                  else payload
    -- Validate total size before processing
    if BS.length decoded < 8
      then return $ Left "Decoded payload too short"
      else return $ processOAuthCallback decoded
